name: Minieri Realty LLC
what_they_do: Family-owned real estate brokerage at 735 Georges Road handling residential and commercial sales; Roy Minieri is the broker/agent. The listed website and its agent pages now fail to load.
customers: Home buyers and sellers and small commercial clients in Middlesex County.

size_signals.signal: One named broker (Roy Minieri); an office number is listed separately from his mobile on a broker directory
realtor.com agent profile shows 5.0 from 8 reviews and Zillow 5.0 from 6 - small review base consistent with a one-person shop

website_review.out_of_date_signs: roysellsnj.com returns a DNS error ('This site can't be reached') in the browser and does not resolve for fetchers; search results still list roysellsnj.com URLs, so the domain lapsed rather than never existing
website_review.search_basics: No site to optimise; visibility now depends entirely on portal profiles (realtor.com, Zillow, LoopNet)
top_issues: Domain does not resolve - profile links from search and portals land on an error page
No home-valuation or listing tool of their own; leads must go through portals
No online way to request a showing, valuation or listing presentation

agent_readiness.notes: Portal profiles carry phone, town and reviews, so the business is findable, but there is no owned site: robots.txt, schema and page copy cannot be checked because the domain does not resolve. Nothing states hours, service area or process in the broker's own words.

operations_signals.signal: Reviews split across Zillow and realtor.com with only a handful each - little systematic review collection
Only phone numbers published, no online intake - inference: inbound leads are handled by phone only

top_opportunities.opportunity: Restore a minimal 3-5 page site on the existing domain (home valuation form, listings, about, contact) with local schema and click-to-call
top_opportunities.evidence: roysellsnj.com fails to resolve in the browser and for fetchers while search still points at its /agents/ page - traffic lands on nothing

top_opportunities.opportunity: AI lead-response: instant reply and follow-up on portal inquiries plus a home-valuation request form
top_opportunities.evidence: No online intake anywhere; leads arrive via realtor.com/Zillow and a mobile number

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated post-closing review requests to consolidate Zillow/realtor.com/Google reviews
top_opportunities.evidence: 5.0 rating but only 6-8 reviews spread over two portals

scores.reasons: The website is completely down, so the gap is maximal and the first deliverable is obvious; but a one-broker brokerage has limited budget; evidence is direct (DNS failure, portal profiles, ratings).
